title: The Wild Ember
author: Jonah Ishikawa
blurb: Isandro Okafor, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
